title: Can Speech Therapy also deal with apraxia in children with Autism?
metaTitle: Treating Apraxia in Children with Autism through Speech Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Find out how Pinnacle Blooms Network's speech therapists deal with Apraxia, a motor speech disorder, in children with Autism. We aim for progress through patience and consistent therapy.
html: Absolutely! Childhood Apraxia of Speech is indeed a challenge that falls within the scope of Speech Therapy. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our experienced therapists work on strategies to improve motor speech control in children, aiding them to articulate sounds and words better. With patience and consistency, progress can certainly be made.
